notes: One interface row per system actor plus the browser client.

value.statement: The system exchanges JSON over HTTPS with the payment gateway and accepts signed webhook callbacks.
The system calls the AI model provider over HTTPS and treats every response as untrusted until parsed.
The system renders diagrams by posting PlantUML source to the render service and storing the returned SVG and PNG.
The product is used in a desktop browser and exports documents as Office Open XML files.
